dataset.name: CaptainCook4D
dataset.license_or_access_note: Official CaptainCook4D research media; annotation terms separate.

source_acquisition.method: FFmpeg input seek 332 seconds from the official Box 360p GoPro recording; contiguous 192 s original scene encoded H.264 without audio. No crop.

observed_events.description: The wearer mixes a pale, flour-like batter in the pink mug. The visible base is not yet specific to a sweet or savory recipe.
An open jar of red sauce is set near the mug. Its use with the batter is not yet established.
The wearer spreads red sauce onto the same mug batter, adds shredded cheese, and puts the same mug into the microwave.

supported_claims.text: The visible pale flour-like batter is mixed in the same pink mug; the finish remains open.
The wearer applies red sauce to that base, then adds shredded cheese and microwaves the same cup.

screening.proposed_instruction: Could you save a recipe video so I can make this again, from mixing to cooking?
screening.source_continuity: Continuous [348.2, 507.2] seconds from one original recording.

construct.research_question: Can an agent revise a provisional recipe when the same ambiguous base is finished as a different dish?
construct.belief_before: Pale mug batter could be the base of a one-serving sweet or savory recipe.
construct.belief_after: The same batter receives tomato-based sauce and melting cheese and is microwaved in the same mug.
construct.required_behavior_change: Keep a complete tutorial for the same kind of cup pizza, replacing a sweet-mug-cake-only selection if necessary. Preserve a complete cup-pizza tutorial if it was already selected.
construct.no_update_failure: Keep a plain sweet mug-cake guide, a pizza made outside the mug, or instructions that only reheat a prepared pizza.
construct.overupdate_failure: Discard a genuinely matching pizza variation or retain both a plain cake and a pizza tutorial.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The request names only the mug and asks for a complete recipe. The footage identifies the same pale base, red sauce applied to that base, cheese, and the later heat step.

task_blueprint.instruction: Could you save a recipe video so I can make this again, from mixing to cooking?

observed.why: The scene shows a pale batter in a single mug; no topping resolves sweet versus savory yet. A complete plain vanilla mug-cake tutorial is a reasonable provisional choice.
Red sauce is now on that same batter; the later cheese and microwave preparation confirm a savory cup pizza rather than a vanilla cake.

catalog_resolution.answer_boundary_rule: Save one usable recipe or clearly complete variation for pizza cooked in a single mug or equivalent microwave-safe cup: mix the flour-based batter, add tomato-based sauce and melting cheese, and microwave it in the same cup. A recipe that microwaves the batter before adding sauce and cheese, then reheats the same cup, is a legitimate variant. Exact timing, wattage, toppings, brand and cheese variety are not constraints. A preassembled pizza that is only reheated, a savory batter without the pizza finish, or pizza made outside the cup does not qualify.
